BREAKING: potential bomb threat reported at Ella Langley’s concert scheduled for tonight at the BOK Center in Tulsa and now has been CANCELLED.

The BOK Center says a serious security threat involving the safety of fans, venue personnel and the artist prompted the decision.

Specific details about the threat have not been released.

The venue says additional information, including ticket refunds, will be announced as soon as possible.

We’ll share updates as more information becomes available.

According to Oklahoma’s News 9, Ella Langley canceled tonight’s concert at the BOK Center in Tulsa after police received a bomb threat call. Even after sweeping the venue and finding no indication of a threat, Ella chose to cancel the show anyway, adding “your safety will always mean more to me than anything else. I refuse to put anyone in harm’s way.”
